statement: For every admissible finite Abelian Cayley presentation in source.md, the least group order for which psi(G) > SDP_GL(G) is 10. Every admissible presentation of order at most 9 is exact. The 16 group-automorphism orbits of admissible presentations on Z_10 give 16 pairwise nonisomorphic graphs, and exactly three are non-exact: S={1,3,7,9}, with (psi,SDP_GL)=(4/5,3/4); S={1,4,6,9}, with (psi,SDP_GL)=(4/5,(15+sqrt(5))/22); and S={1,2,5,8,9}, with (psi,SDP_GL)=(5/6,(10+sqrt(5))/15). Thus these are precisely the three order-ten non-exact graph-isomorphism classes, and each has one Cayley-presentation orbit.
contribution: This supplies the previously absent exact minimum-order proof and complete order-ten classification requested by the frozen problem. It combines the cited exponent-at-most-four theorem with exhaustive finite orbit and cut coverage, serialized exact rational and Q(sqrt(5)) GL certificates, a balanced complete-multipartite exactness argument, and exact characteristic-polynomial separation. Priority is not asserted beyond the bounded literature comparison recorded in problem.md.
